added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate fields: its after_suite (cocos-graph-head.log, rev 5b040644) records 53 passed, EXIT=0, 0 failures, so no failure was added; its baseline_suite field is empty, so reckon's reader reports the count as unmeasured rather than zero. The added set is empty either way because the head arm carries no failure.

findings.text: validate_cocos_from_data still calls the rebuilt determine_cocos, which now raises ValueError when the observations contradict (status not-cocos-expressible) or the psi gradient is zero, so the validator raises for exactly the inconsistent inputs it exists to report and its documented ValidationResult contract is broken. Reproduction at head 5b040644: validate_cocos_from_data(declared_cocos=17, psi_axis=0.0, psi_edge=1.0, ip=1e6, b0=5.0, dp_dpsi=1e3) raises ValueError('Equilibrium observations are not-cocos-expressible'), while at base 6c7be873 the same call returns ValidationResult(is_consistent=False, inconsistencies=['psi gradient: expected decreasing, got increasing (sigmaIp=1, sigmaBp=-1)']). Production call sites imas_codex/llm/server.py:1343 and :1391 forward without catching, so an LLM tool call now surfaces an unhandled exception; fix by having validate_cocos_from_data record the not-cocos-expressible state as an inconsistency rather than propagating the raise.

dd_cocos_class is verified only by tests/cocos/test_cocos_survivors.py:73 whose mock re-implements the query's ordering, so the real Cypher at imas_codex/cocos/transforms.py:20-31 (ORDER BY candidate.depth DESC over IMASNode ids against path prefixes) is confirmed by no recorded artifact; the reviewed manifest's evidence_inputs claims a live graph probe returned psi_like for magnetics/flux_loop/flux/data, but no log in the run directory and no bolt:// URI in the stream record that query, so the claim is uncorroborated. Add the live-probe log or an EXPLAIN-level check of the statement.

the new exported dataclass COCOSDetermination reuses the exact name of the auto-generated enum imas_codex/graph/models.py:452 (values metadata/calculated/documented/asserted), so 'from imas_codex.cocos import COCOSDetermination' and 'from imas_codex.graph.models import COCOSDetermination' name different concepts; the second commit's body says it renamed records to avoid a schema class collision, but this one remains, so rename it by what it holds (for example COCOSEquilibriumDetermination) or state the deliberate reuse.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against the base; 3f8e6cd adds SignObservation/COCOSSurvivorResult/score_cocos_survivors and rebuilds determine_cocos on them, and 5b040644 replaces dd_cocos_class with a graph ancestor query and renames the observation record.
item_verdicts.done_when: every clause has a recorded, independently reproduced artifact — tests/cocos/test_cocos_survivors.py:26 asserts survivors {3,4} at e_bp=0, :29 asserts the unanimous 2*pi psi_like factor and :30 the split ip_like None, :35 one survivor under a declaration, :47 polarity-incomplete with lowered confidence, :57 not-cocos-expressible, :64 determine_cocos returning the unique survivor with assumed e_bp and sigma_r_phi_z, :105 dd_cocos_class psi_like for magnetics/flux_loop/flux/data and :130 None for an unlabelled path; my own rerun of tests/cocos records 53 passed, EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: plan §5's core node asks a survivor scorer to filter the sixteen canonical conventions from measured signs and explicit declarations and a dd_cocos_class resolver to read a DD class through its ancestors; imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:207 score_cocos_survivors and imas_codex/cocos/transforms.py:13 dd_cocos_class implement both, and imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:300 rebuilds determine_cocos on the scorer.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, names both commits and cocos-graph-head.log (53 passed, EXIT=0), and carries a red negative-control log, but its baseline_suite field is empty so no baseline arm is recorded, and its evidence_inputs claims a live graph probe with no log artifact in the run directory or stream.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; git diff 6c7be873..5b040644 touches only imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py, imas_codex/cocos/transforms.py, imas_codex/cocos/__init__.py and tests/cocos/test_cocos_survivors.py, all inside them and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/cocos/test_cocos_survivors.py:23-131 assert behaviour against independent literals and the negative control reddens the one-survivor case at EXIT=1, but the ValueError path the rebuild added to imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:300 and its effect on validate_cocos_from_data at :457 carry no test, so the changed refusal is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: cocos-graph-head.log records rev 5b040644 with the wrong signature, ugly hack and 0 failures and my independent rerun agrees (53 passed, EXIT=0), and negative-control-graph-head.log is red at EXIT=1, but the reviewed manifest records no baseline_suite arm and no log corroborates the live graph probe its evidence_inputs claims.
justifications.fit: the change follows the module's frozen-dataclass and Literal idioms with conventional commits carrying bodies, but the new dataclass COCOSDetermination at imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:285 reuses the name of the auto-generated enum imas_codex/graph/models.py:452.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:207-282 filters VALID_COCOS by measured signs and declared e_bp/sigma_r_phi_z/sigma_rho_theta_phi, reports polarity-incomplete and not-cocos-expressible, and imas_codex/cocos/transforms.py:13 resolves the DD class through ancestor prefixes, meeting the stated goal while the determine_cocos rebuild silently changed a sibling validator's contract (see the blocking finding).
justifications.reuse: imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:207 extends the owner module of COCOS identification and reuses cocos_to_parameters, and imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py:196 reuses the existing cocos_sign from imas_codex/ids/transforms.py, forking no capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 6c7be873..5b040644 touches only the four declared write paths (imas_codex/cocos/calculator.py, imas_codex/cocos/transforms.py, imas_codex/cocos/__init__.py, tests/cocos/test_cocos_survivors.py) with no out-of-scope edit.
